item.title: CBC Tech, GTT Integrate ServiceNow for Seamless Enterprise Service Management
item.summary: CBC Tech has announced the successful integration of ServiceNow Service Bridge with GTT. This integration fosters improved collaboration between the two businesses, offering a cohesive digital service experience for multinational enterprise clients.
